notes_blind_original: Scope: R Rmd using author-provided contextual_probabilities.RDS (as in claims-file note); replicators edited gsub(xx[1]) -> gsub(xx) for LaTeX table formatting only (display, no numeric effect). I checked the shipped outputs at the pinned commit: tables/table1.tex (gender any-false diff -0.080; digital-literacy 0.101), tables/table2.tex (Accuracy any-false -0.023), tables/table3.tex (FB-tips group diff 0.065; accuracy group -0.021) all match the printed text, so the report's remark 'original numbers for Facebook tips don't match table 3' does not hold for the shipped table; it likely refers to their own rerun. The rerun differences (also fact-check 0.4 vs -0.6, related articles 0.1 vs 0.8, Figure 3 covariate significance flips) were consistent across Windows/Linux/macOS, suggesting grf/package-version dependence (main Rmd sets set.seed(60637) but no package versions are pinned). Paper-level 'computational issues' rests on Table 3 and Figure 3; C1/C2/C4 close-vs-discrepant is the main boundary to reconcile.
